Mi Yitneni Eved Elo'ah Oseni ("Servant of God"), a piyyut by Yehudah ha-Levi (adapted rhyming English translation by Alice Lucas, 1894)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Yehudah ben Shmuel haLevi
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: “Servant of God” is an adapted English rhmying translation by Alice Montefiore Lucas of a piyyut by Yehudah haLevi, first published in the former’s first collection of translations Songs of Zion by Hebrew Singers of Mediæval Times (1894), pp. 9-12. In The Jewish Year (1898), Lucas selects this piyyut for a devotional reading on Yom Kippur. I have set the Hebrew source text of Yehudah ha-Levi’s piyyut side-by-side with Lucas’s English verse. Many thanks to Nir Krakauer for identifying the piyyut and to Project Ben Yehuda for making a digital transcription of the Hebrew source text available.
